David spoke to Yahweh the words of this song in the day that Yahweh delivered him out of the hand of all his enemies…
Then they believed his words. They sang his praise.
Let them praise Yahweh for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds to the children of men!

Let them offer the sacrifices of thanksgiving, and declare his deeds with singing.
In that day you will say, “I will give thanks to you, Yahweh; for though you were angry with me, your anger has turned…
Isn’t it you who dried up the sea, the waters of the great deep; who made the depths of the sea a way for the redeemed…

Behold, I myself will harden the hearts of the Egyptians, and they will go in after them. I will get myself honor over…

Now I know that Yahweh is greater than all gods because of the way that they treated people arrogantly.”
Having stripped the principalities and the powers, he made a show of them openly, triumphing over them in it.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: Then Moses and the children of Israel sang this song to Yahweh, and said, “I will sing to Yahweh, for he has triumphed gloriously. He has thrown the horse and his rider into the sea.
translations.bsb: Then Moses and the Israelites sang this song to the LORD: “I will sing to the LORD, for He is highly exalted. The horse and rider He has thrown into the sea.
translations.kjv: Then sang Moses and the children of Israel this song unto the LORD, and spake, saying, I will sing unto the LORD, for he hath triumphed gloriously: the horse and his rider hath he thrown into the sea.
translations.asv: Then sang Moses and the children of Israel this song unto Jehovah, and spake, saying, I will sing unto Jehovah, for he hath triumphed gloriously: The horse and his rider hath he thrown into the sea.
